search.title: List available locations as GeoJSON FeatureCollection

methods.why: Tafmetar /locations prints airport location names (KRISTIANSUND/ KVERNBERGET, NOTODDEN, …). That is not a numeric time series with a year-like period field. methods/ was not edited.

notes: Ids are copied from printed swagger path last segments. access_path is swagger origin + printed basePath + path. No tafmetar id was written onto a met, nowcast, radar, oceanforecast, airquality, tidalwater, sunrise, spotwind, textforecast, icemap, or datanorge row.
License is the printed swagger CC BY 4.0 URL http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0. Publisher is null: the spec prints contact.name Developer Support, not a publisher.
Original harvested swagger metadata stays in harvested_payloads. Fetch writes observations only. enrichments count stayed 0.

Nowcast stays --source nowcast. Metalerts stays --source met. Airqualityforecast stays --source airquality. Tidalwater stays --source tidalwater. Oceanforecast stays --source oceanforecast. Sunrise stays --source sunrise. Radar stays --source radar. Spotwind stays --source spotwind. Textforecast stays --source textforecast. Icemap stays --source icemap after PR 108. Lane B NCAgalewarnings stays PR 107. This source does not re-implement those.
TAF/METAR product paths /info /metar /taf /tafmetar and root / print required icao and were not ingested. Fetch in this slice uses /locations so ICAO is not invented.
Not a numeric time series with two or more periods.
